title: IL: Wilmington School District 209U Reports Ransomware Attack And Possible Data Breach
content_md: WJOL reports: Officials in Wilmington are investigating a possible ransomware attack and data breach at Wilmington School District 209U. There was a message sent to district staff and student families from Superintendent Kevin Feeney that said cybersecurity experts are attempting to determine the extent of the attack and whether any sensitive information was accessed.
